sourceBeforeAcceptanceRecord.domain: tracked + non-ignored untracked source/assets; generated outputs excluded

sourceNote: Fingerprint taken before writing this acceptance record. Final committed source is identified by the containing Git commit. Evidence spans the listed development/static snapshots.
owner: Codex integrator; three scene production/review workers

playback.interpretation: End-to-end clock progress with periodic observation and explicit sampling gaps, predominantly silent and often eight concurrent films. Not frame-by-frame human review, full listening, or stable physical-phone performance.

transcription.method: Independent mlx Whisper large-v3-turbo, no language hint or reference prompt; textual checks only.
transcription.limitation: Current script text is matched. This aggregation does not re-encode slices to recompute audioSha256 and is not a fresh transcription or human listening test.

notRun: Full listening in both languages: actual audio input unsupported
Frame-by-frame human watching of all 100 films
Complete browser-engine matrix for all new scenes

faultChecks.sceneChunk404: explicit unavailable state; article remained readable
faultChecks.audio404: retry prompt and silent progression; successful recovery not established; notice can exceed short viewport

automatedChecks.releaseGate: Actions must pass on the publishing commit

publication: Use the Actions run and live audit for the containing commit; this record is local review evidence.
